subheader: The starting price above, the bands below
lead: Each row is a quantity range with its rate. Readers see the starting price first, then how it falls.
note: The note says when seats are counted and how a seat added mid-period is billed.

bands.text: The range is the row header, so screen readers link each rate to its band.
The figures line up, so you can see the rate fall.
A band can list anything else that changes with volume.

bands.title: 41 and above
bands.text: The last band often invites the reader to get in touch.
